title: ANCA-Associated Glomerulonephritis: Pathophysiology, Serology, Renal Histopathology & KDIGO 2024 Guidelines
description: 整合 ANCA AAV NETosis, Complement C5aR、Berden Classification, Brix Score、KDIGO 2024 Avacopan, PEXIVAS, RTX 及藥物誘發型 ANCA 血管炎之專科講堂。

sections.title: Module 1: Molecular Pathophysiology, ANCA Serologies & Clinical Spectrum (GPA, MPA, EGPA, RLV)
sections.content:
### 1. Molecular Pathophysiology & Serology Matrix

ANCA-Associated Vasculitis (AAV) Necrotizing Small-Vessel Vasculitis Pauci-Immune Crescentic Glomerulonephritis 為特徵的全身性自體免疫疾病。其致病核心包含 Neutrophil Priming、ANCA-Mediated Neutrophil Activation、Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETosis) 的釋放，以及 Alternative Complement Pathway 的正回饋活化。補體 C5a 結合至 Neutrophils 表面之 C5a Receptor (C5aR / CD88)，會引發極強烈的 Chemoattraction 與 Priming，使 Proteinase 3 (PR3) 及 Myeloperoxidase (MPO) 易位至細胞膜表面。當 Autoantibodies (PR3-ANCA 或 MPO-ANCA) 結合後，驅動 Neutrophils 釋放 Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) 與 Lytic Enzymes，引發 Endothelial Necrosis 及 Fibrinoid Extravasation。

| Disease Phenotype | Primary Target Autoantigen | ANCA Staining Pattern | Granulomatous Inflammation | Primary Organ Tropism & Clinical Features |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA) | Proteinase 3 (PR3) | c-ANCA (Cytoplasmic) | Present (Necrotizing Granulomas) | Upper respiratory tract (Epistaxis, Saddle nose), Pulmonary cavitary nodules, Rapidly Progressive Glomerulonephritis (RPGN) |
| Microscopic Polyangiitis (MPA) | Myeloperoxidase (MPO) | p-ANCA (Perinuclear) | Absent | Pulmonary Capillaritis with Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage (DAH), Severe Pauci-Immune Crescentic GN, Absence of granulomas |
| Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (EGPA) | Myeloperoxidase (MPO in 40-50%) | p-ANCA (Perinuclear) | Present (Eosinophil-rich Granulomas) | Severe refractory Asthma, Peripheral Eosinophilia, Mononeuritis Multiplex, Glomerulonephritis (less frequent, ~25%) |
| Renal-Limited Vasculitis (RLV) | MPO (majority) or PR3 | p-ANCA or c-ANCA | Absent in kidney | Isolated Pauci-Immune Necrotizing Crescentic GN without extrarenal systemic vasculitis involvement |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Diagnostic Parameter | Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA) | Microscopic Polyangiitis (MPA) | Anti-GBM Disease (Goodpasture) | Lupus Nephritis (Class III/IV) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Predominant Serology | PR3-ANCA (c-ANCA) | MPO-ANCA (p-ANCA) | Anti-α3(IV)NC1 Antibodies | Anti-dsDNA, Anti-Sm |
| Complement Levels (C3/C4) | Normal | Normal | Normal | Low C3 and Low C4 (Hypocomplementemia) |
| Immunofluorescence (IF) | Pauci-immune (Negative / Trace) | Pauci-immune (Negative / Trace) | Linear IgG along GBM | Full-House (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q) |
| Electron Microscopy (EM) | Subendothelial/Subepithelial deposits ABSENT | Deposits ABSENT | Deposits ABSENT | Abundant Subendothelial / Subepithelial deposits |
| Pulmonary Involvement | Cavitary nodules, Infiltrates | Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage (DAH) | Pulmonary Hemorrhage (No nodules) | Pleuritis, Lupus Pneumonitis |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Patient presenting with Acute Kidney Injury & Hematuria (RPGN Pattern) ➔ Measure Serum Complement Levels (C3 & C4) ➔ Normal C3 & C4 ➔ Order Serologic Autoantibody Panel (ANCA, Anti-GBM, ANA) ➔ Positive PR3-ANCA / c-ANCA ➔ Evaluate Upper Respiratory & Pulmonary CT ➔ Presence of Cavitary Lesions / Sinusitis ➔ Diagnosis: Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA) ➔ Positive MPO-ANCA / p-ANCA ➔ Assess Pulmonary Symptoms ➔ Asthma & Peripheral Eosinophilia present ➔ Diagnosis: EGPA ➔ Isolated RPGN without granulomas/asthma ➔ Diagnosis: Microscopic Polyangiitis (MPA) or Renal-Limited Vasculitis (RLV).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為只有 c-ANCA 陽性才能診斷 GPA，或是只要 p-ANCA 陽性就一定代表 MPO-ANCA 血管炎。
**Analysis**: 免疫螢光 staining 的 p-ANCA 圖譜在很多非血管炎疾病（如 Inflammatory Bowel Disease, Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, Autoimmune Hepatitis）中也會呈陽性，這是因為 Anti-Lactoferrin, Anti-Elastase, Anti-Cathepsin G 等非特異性抗體的干擾。因此，金標準必須經由 Antigen-Specific ELISA 或 Chemiluminescence Immunoassay (CLIA) 定量確認為 PR3-ANCA 或 MPO-ANCA。此外，約有 10-15% 的 GPA 患者呈現 MPO-ANCA 陽性，5-10% 的 MPA 患者呈現 PR3-ANCA 陽性；治療決策在最新指引中更傾向於依據 ANCA Subtype (PR3 vs MPO) 而非病理分類。

sections.title: Module 2: Renal Histopathology, Berden Classification & Brix Renal Risk Score
sections.content:
### 1. Renal Histopathology & Berden Classification Matrix

ANCA-Associated Glomerulonephritis 的特徵性病理變態為 Break in Glomerular Basement Membrane (GBM) 繼發的 Segmental Fibrinoid Necrosis 及 Parietal Epithelial Cell (PEC) hyperplasia所形成的 Cellular Crescents。IF 檢查呈現 Pauci-immune 特徵 (無或僅有些微之 Immunoglobulin 及 Complement 沉積)，EM 無特異性 Electron-dense Deposits。為預測腎臟Prognosis與 Renal Survival，Berden 等人於 2010 年提出了 ANCA Glomerulonephritis Berden Histopathologic Classification；爾後 Brix 等人於 2018 年發展出結合組織學與 Baseline eGFR 的 Brix Renal Risk Score。

| Berden Histopathologic Class | Histologic Definition / Criteria | Long-Term Renal Prognosis (ESRD Risk) | Clinical & Therapeutic Implications |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Focal Class | ≥ 50% Normal Glomeruli (without necrosis or crescents) | Best Renal Survival (Lowest risk of ESRD) | Highly responsive to standard immunosuppression; High potential for eGFR recovery |
| Crescentic Class | ≥ 50% Glomeruli with Cellular / Fibrocellular Crescents | Intermediate Prognosis (High risk if untreated, but salvageable) | Represents active inflammatory injury; Requires aggressive immediate induction therapy |
| Mixed Class | < 50% Normal, < 50% Crescentic, < 50% Sclerotic Glomeruli | Intermediate Prognosis | Variable response dependent on ratio of active vs chronic lesions |
| Sclerotic Class | ≥ 50% Globally Sclerotic Glomeruli | Worst Renal Survival (Highest risk of ESRD / Dialysis Dependence) | Represents irreversible chronic scarring; High risk of treatment toxicity with low renal benefit |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Histopathologic Parameter | Active Glomerular Lesions | Chronic / Irreversible Glomerular Lesions | Brix Renal Risk Score Component |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Glomerular Changes | Fibrinoid Necrosis, Karyorrhexis, Cellular Crescents | Fibrous Crescents, Global Sclerosis, Segmental Sclerosis | Percentage of Normal Glomeruli (Points: >25% = 0, 10-25% = 4, <10% = 6) |
| Tubulointerstitial Changes | Interstitial Neutrophilic & Lymphocytic Infiltrates | Tubular Atrophy & Interstitial Fibrosis (TA/IF) | Percentage of TA/IF (Points: ≤25% = 0, >25% = 2) |
| Vascular Lesions | Leukocytoclastic Vasculitis, Fibrinoid Necrosis of Arterioles | Arteriosclerosis, Intimal Fibrosis | Not explicitly scored in Brix, but predicts vascular resistance |
| Baseline eGFR Factor | Indicates acute functional impairment (potentially reversible) | Indicates underlying loss of nephron mass | Baseline eGFR (Points: ≥15 mL/min = 0, <15 mL/min = 3) |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Kidney Biopsy performed for Suspected ANCA Glomerulonephritis ➔ Immunofluorescence Microscopy ➔ Pauci-Immune (Negative/Trace IgG, C3) ➔ Light Microscopy Evaluation ➔ Count Percentage of Glomeruli in each category ➔ Normal Glomeruli ≥ 50% ➔ Classify as Focal Class (Favorable prognosis) ➔ Cellular/Fibrocellular Crescents ≥ 50% ➔ Classify as Crescentic Class (Active inflammatory, urgent induction) ➔ Globally Sclerotic Glomeruli ≥ 50% ➔ Classify as Sclerotic Class (High ESRD risk) ➔ Does not meet 50% threshold for any ➔ Classify as Mixed Class.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 誤認為只要切片看到 >50% Crescents 就代表極差Prognosis、無法恢復，因而放棄積極治療。
**Analysis**: 在 Berden 分型中，Crescentic Class 指的是 >50% 的新形成 Cellular Crescents。Cellular Crescent 代表的是「Active Inflammatory Lesion」，在強效免疫抑制劑 (如 Pulse Steroids, RTX, CYC) Reversibility。真正Prognosis最差、缺乏恢復潛力的是 Sclerotic Class (>50% Globally Sclerotic Glomeruli) 及廣泛的 Fibrous Crescents 與 Severe Tubular Atrophy / Interstitial Fibrosis (TA/IF)。對 Crescentic Class 積極治療仍能挽救相當比例的腎功能。

sections.title: Module 3: KDIGO 2024 Guidelines on Remission Induction Therapy & Glucocorticoid Sparing (PEXIVAS & Avacopan)
sections.content:
### 1. Therapeutic Induction Matrix (KDIGO 2021 / 2024 Updates)

KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline Update 對於 ANCA-Associated Vasculitis (AAV) 的 Remission Induction 建立了嶄新的治療典範。傳統的高劑量 Cyclophosphamide (CYC) 合併長程高劑量 Glucocorticoids 已被新的低毒性、極簡化口服與標靶選擇所取代。特別是基於 PEXIVAS Trial 與 ADVOCATE Trial 的地標性實證，極大地改變了 Plasma Exchange (PLEX) 的角色、Glucocorticoid 減量協定以及 C5a Receptor Antagonist (Avacopan) 的臨床地位。

| Induction Strategy Component | First-Line Recommendation | Alternative Option / Subgroup Preference | Key Clinical Trial & Evidence Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Organ- / Life-Threatening AAV | Rituximab (RTX 375 mg/m² x4 or 1000 mg x2) OR Pulse CYC (Oral/IV) + Low-dose Corticosteroids | RTX is strongly preferred for PR3-ANCA, relapsing disease, and pediatric/fertile patients | RAVE Trial & RITUXVAS Trial (Non-inferiority of RTX to CYC) |
| Glucocorticoid Regimen | PEXIVAS Reduced-Dose Glucocorticoid Protocol (Rapid Taper over 2-5 months) | Standard-dose Glucocorticoid (Historical, higher infection risk) | PEXIVAS Trial (Reduced-dose non-inferior for remission/death/ESRD, 50% drop in serious infections) |
| C5a Receptor Targeted Therapy | Avacopan (30 mg BID orally) combined with RTX or CYC | Used to eliminate or minimize oral Glucocorticoids | ADVOCATE Trial (Avacopan superior in 52-week sustained remission & eGFR recovery) |
| Plasma Exchange (PLEX) | NOT routinely recommended for all patients | Restricted to Serum Creatinine ≥ 5.7 mg/dL (500 μmol/L), DAH with hypoxemia, or Dual Anti-GBM | PEXIVAS Trial (No reduction in 1-year/long-term death or ESRD for PLEX in unselected AAV) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Pharmacologic Agent | Target Mechanism | Dosing & Route | Major Adverse Effects & Safety Cautions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rituximab (RTX) | Anti-CD20 Monoclonal Antibody (B-cell Depletion) | 375 mg/m² weekly x4 IV OR 1000 mg IV on days 1 & 15 | Hypogammaglobulinemia, HBV reactivation, Late-onset neutropenia, Infusion reactions |
| Cyclophosphamide (CYC) | Alkylating Agent (DNA Cross-linking) | Pulsed IV 15 mg/kg every 2-3 weeks OR Oral 1.5-2 mg/kg/d | Leukopenia, Hemorrhagic Cystitis (mitigated by MESNA/hydration), Infertility, Bladder Cancer |
| Avacopan | Selective Complement C5a Receptor (C5aR/CD88) Antagonist | 30 mg PO BID with food | Transient Transaminitis (Monitor LFTs), Headaches, Nausea (Preserves C5b-9 MAC defenses) |
| Glucocorticoids | Broad Genomic & Non-Genomic Anti-Inflammatory | IV Methylprednisolone 0.5-1g x3d ➔ Oral Prednisone rapidly tapered | Severe Infections, Steroid Myopathy, Osteoporosis, Hyperglycemia, Cataracts, Psychosis |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Newly Diagnosed Active ANCA Glomerulonephritis ➔ Assess Organ Severity & Features ➔ Severe RPGN / Organ-Threatening Disease ➔ Select Induction Backbone ➔ Is Patient PR3-ANCA+, Relapsing, or Young/Fertile? ➔ YES ➔ Select Rituximab (RTX) + Reduced-Dose Glucocorticoids ➔ Is Avacopan Available? ➔ YES ➔ Add Avacopan 30mg BID and rapidly taper Corticosteroids to zero by Week 4 ➔ Check Serum Creatinine & Lung Involvement ➔ Serum Cr ≥ 5.7 mg/dL or Severe DAH with Hypoxemia or Dual Anti-GBM+ ➔ YES ➔ Add Plasma Exchange (PLEX) ➔ NO ➔ Omit Plasma Exchange.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為只要看到患者有 Rapidly Progressive GN 與 ANCA 陽性，就必須立刻安排 Plasma Exchange (血漿置換 / PLEX)。
**Analysis**: 過去的 MEPEX Trial 曾建議對 Scr > 5.7 mg/dL 的患者使用 PLEX。然而 2020 年發表的目前最大規模隨機對照試驗 **PEXIVAS Trial** (n=704) 證實：在整體 AAV 患者中，加用 PLEX 並無法降低 1 年及長期的全死因死亡率或進展至 ESRD 的風險。因此 KDIGO 2024 指引已**取消 PLEX 的常規推薦**！目前的限制性適應症僅保留給：(1) 重度 Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage (DAH) 伴隨低氧血症；(2) 同時合併 Anti-GBM 陽性之 Dual-Positive 患者；(3) 難治性極重度 AKI (Scr ≥ 5.7 mg/dL) 且經過嚴格評估個體化利弊者。

sections.title: Module 4: Maintenance Therapy, Relapse Management, Drug-Induced ANCA Vasculitis & Kidney Transplantation
sections.content:
### 1. Maintenance & Special Scenarios Matrix

在 Remission Induction Complete Remission 後，Maintenance Therapy Relapse 並最小化長期藥物毒性。KDIGO 2024 指引強烈推薦使用 **Rituximab (RTX)** 作為首選 Maintenance 藥物，其預防復發之效果顯著優於 Azathioprine (MAINRITSAN Trial)。針對高復發風險因子 (如 PR3-ANCA 陽性、既往有 Relapse 史、呼吸道侵犯殘留)，RTX 維持治療應持續至少 18 至 24 個月。此外，臨床上必須與 **Drug-Induced ANCA Vasculitis** 進行明確鑑別，Kidney Transplantation 的最適時機。

| Clinical Category | Preferred First-Line Strategy | Second-Line / Alternative Strategy | Key Monitoring & Clinical Pitfalls |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Maintenance Therapy | Rituximab 500 mg or 1000 mg IV every 6 months for 18-24 months | Oral Azathioprine (1.5-2 mg/kg/d) OR Mycophenolate Mofetil (MMF) | Monitor Serum IgG levels (risk of hypogammaglobulinemia) and Peripheral CD19/20 B-cell counts |
| Relapse Risk Stratification | High Risk: PR3-ANCA+, Persistent Seropositivity, ENT/Lung involvement ➔ Extend RTX > 2 years | Low Risk: MPO-ANCA+, Renal-limited, Prompt seroconversion ➔ Consider 18-month RTX tapering | Serial ANCA titers rising alone WITHOUT clinical signs is NOT an automatic mandate to escalate therapy |
| Drug-Induced ANCA Vasculitis | Immediate withdrawal of offending drug (Hydralazine, PTU, Minocycline, Levamisole) | Immunosuppression (Steroids ± RTX/CYC) only if severe organ-threatening disease | High prevalence of p-ANCA / MPO-ANCA, often DUAL positive (PR3+MPO), positive Anti-Histone antibodies |
| Kidney Transplantation | Proceed when patient is in complete clinical remission for ≥ 6 months | Persistent low-titer ANCA in complete clinical remission is NOT an absolute contraindication | Recurrence rate post-transplant is low (~5-10%); Excellent long-term graft survival |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | Idiopathic MPO-ANCA Vasculitis | Drug-Induced ANCA Vasculitis (e.g. Hydralazine / PTU) | Anti-GBM Disease Recurrence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Offending Triggers | None (Autoimmune etiology) | Hydralazine, Propylthiouracil (PTU), Minocycline, Levamisole | None |
| ANCA Serology Pattern | MPO-ANCA (p-ANCA) predominant | Frequently DUAL Positive (MPO-ANCA + PR3-ANCA), Anti-Elastase+ | Negative (Anti-GBM positive) |
| Associated Autoantibodies | ANA usually negative | Anti-Histone Antibodies (+), ANA (+), Anti-Lactoferrin (+) | Anti-α3(IV)NC1 antibodies (+)|
| Clinical Course after Withdrawal | Requires full induction & maintenance immunosuppression | Spontaneous resolution or rapid improvement after drug cessation | Requires plasma exchange & aggressive immunosuppression |
| Transplant Recurrence | Low (~5-10% post-transplant) | Extremely rare once drug is stopped | Near zero if Anti-GBM antibodies negative for ≥6 months |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Patient in Complete Remission following Induction Therapy ➔ Evaluate Relapse Risk Factors ➔ PR3-ANCA positive OR History of Prior Relapse ➔ Initiate Rituximab Maintenance (500-1000 mg IV q6m for ≥ 24 months) ➔ Monitor B-cell CD19 Count & Serum IgG ➔ Is Serum IgG < 300 mg/dL with Recurrent Infections? ➔ YES ➔ Administer IVIG replacement & space out RTX ➔ Is Patient Suspected of Drug-Induced ANCA (Hydralazine/PTU history)? ➔ YES ➔ Discontinue offending agent immediately ➔ Check Dual ANCA & Anti-Histone ➔ Mild disease improves spontaneously ➔ Avoid prolonged cytotoxic immunosuppression.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為在 Maintenance 期間只要追蹤血清 ANCA Titer 升高，就必須立刻加強免疫抑制劑 (如給予 Steroid Pulse 或加重 RTX)。
**Analysis**: 血清 ANCA Titer Rising ANCA Titer 或 Seroconversion 確實與未來復發風險增加有關，但單憑 Titer 升高而無任何臨床發炎跡象（如無鏡檢血尿、無 Proteinuria 增加、無 eGFR 下降、無呼吸道或全身症狀），**絕不能作為加強免疫抑制劑的唯一理由**！Infection 與 Hypogammaglobulinemia 致命風險。正確原則是：密切追蹤臨床尿液與生化數據，Clinical Relapse 時始調整治療方案。
